0022600157.text: The Lakers host the Raptors in their 7th game of the season, with Los Angeles at 4-2 and first in the Pacific, 7th in the West, after a one-game losing streak, while Toronto is 3-2, third in the Atlantic and 2 games back, and fifth in the East, also on a one-game losing streak. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (day-to-day, foot, game-time decision), and Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Lakers won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 110-93 win in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
